cost.note: The reservation is charged even on failure. The estimate applies published token rates to reported usage; it is not a billing record.

visualReview.fix: Rebuilt each divert indicator set as a two-row white callout 88-158 units above the belt: title row, then PLC square / Home circle / Ext circle spaced with gaps, then a separate Pos row; no label touches another label or lamp.
visualReview.issue: L01-L05: 'PLC cmd' overlapped 'Home' and covered the Home lamps and paddle area on both diverts in every snapshot.

visualReview.fix: Position text now sits alone on its own row in the callout, starting at local x=-48 with clear space to the box edge, reserving room for 'unknown' and up to 10 digits; it is vertically separated from the photoeye labels below the callouts.
visualReview.issue: L02-L03: Divert position 'unknown' values overlapped the PE D2 Approach and PE Runout labels.

visualReview.fix: All divert labels moved into the above-lane callouts, far above the paddle swing envelope (paddle rotates only below y about -24 local); paddle AABB no longer reaches any text.
visualReview.issue: L06-L09: Divert labels lay on the rotating paddles when extended.

visualReview.fix: Every label and lamp moved off the travel bands: main photoeye lamps 48 units above the main centreline with labels above them, divert lamps in callouts above the lane, exit/runout lamps in horizontal south-west callouts 60+ units from chute centrelines; passing carton boxes (about 18 units half-height) cannot reach them.
visualReview.issue: L10-L16 and general transient overlap: carton itemId/route text covered on-lane labels (Ext, Pos%, PLC cmd, Home, Exit Ready) as cartons passed.

visualReview.fix: All label classes raised to 12 user units, values 12, fine print 12, and carton route text to 11; no 9-10 px text remains.
visualReview.issue: L17: Many labels rendered below 10 px at 1280 px width (9.6 px).

visualReview.fix: Each branch path now has 7 segments over the first 0.35 m with headings 6,12,18,24,30,36,36 degrees (about 6 degrees per 0.05 m step) before continuing at 36 degrees; drawn chutes use the identical polylines and still start exactly on the main path.
visualReview.issue: M02: Carton heading snapped about 34.8 degrees in one frame at each branch.

visualReview.fix: Added explicit [data-cb-source=plc] violet stroke/fill rules versus [data-cb-source=world] teal rules in addition to square-versus-circle shapes, violet frames around PLC stack lamps, and a legend stating the coding; unknown remains white dashed, distinct from pale-solid false.
visualReview.issue: Audit instruction: PLC versus world distinction relied on shape alone in the incumbent.

visualReview.fix: Photoeye beam circles moved from the belt centreline to 48 units above it with a short leader to the sensor head; the beam line itself remains across the belt as the physical sensor glyph.
visualReview.issue: Self-observed: incumbent photoeye beam indicators sat on the belt centreline, so cartons completely hid the very lamp showing beam state.

visualReview.fix: Exit PE and Exit Ready text now lives in a nested rotate(-36) subgroup that cancels the anchored rotation, rendering horizontal text south-west of the chute with a leader line, clear of both chute and main lane.
visualReview.issue: Self-observed: incumbent exit labels were rotated 35 degrees on the chutes, hard to read and with diagonal bounding boxes encroaching on lamps and cartons.

visualReview.fix: Removed the long flow arrow line; flow is now stated only in the footer text and station order, and leader lines stop short of every label.
visualReview.issue: Self-observed: incumbent long flow line at y=340 crossed both chutes and passed under/through label areas, a decorative line through the reading field.

visualReview.fix: Side-panel numeric values are end-anchored at x=1170 with a reserved field, so worst-case counts (4294967295) and 'unknown' grow leftwards into empty reserved space, never into the label.
visualReview.issue: Self-observed: incumbent side-panel values were start-anchored immediately after short labels, so a 10-digit encoder count could run toward the panel edge and crowd neighbouring text.

visualReview.fix: Photoeye labels moved to the staggered row above the belt (labels at local y=-66, lamps at y=-48, divert callouts ending at y=-88 local), giving at least 10 units vertical clearance between rows at different heights.
visualReview.issue: Self-observed: incumbent below-belt photoeye labels for D2 Approach sat close to the Exit A chute diagonal and could be clipped by diverted cartons.

visualReview.fix: Preserved: the red 'NOT the PLC HMI' caption, labelled side panel for unlocated drive/encoder/stack light, all 15 selectable equipment groups, common 180 px/m scale, full channel binding coverage, unknown-distinct-from-false styling.
visualReview.issue: Preservation check: features that worked in the incumbent (caption, side panel, selectability, scale, coverage) had to survive the revision.

policy: One bounded call. No retry. The candidate replaces the incumbent only if it is view-valid, passes the browser check and has fewer audit errors (or equal errors and fewer warnings).
